frozen: 2026-10-31, before any result of this search; after the first dry-heating refit (calibration/dry_heat_refit_20261031: dev31 0.9879, 28 km 0.9893, first 31-Oct sealed set 1.0405) and the e54d screens on dev31 and on that retired sealed set (output/dry_heat_v2_20261031; reports/TRANSPORT_WIND_20261031.md section 9)
why: The retired sealed set showed what failed: the cold-high storm damping made Hokkaido more continental, the water-wind land friction starved the Kazakh steppe, and summer dry heating warmed cold steppes. e54d lets dry heating act only where the annual-mean land equilibrium is warm; with no frictions and r40's storm damping (v1) dev31 gives 0.9881 (T -2.3 %) and the retired set 0.9936, but Manchuria and eastern Europe fail the mid-latitude group (1.010). The search balances dry heating, its gates, the storm damping, the winter overturning and the rain time scale with the retired set as an extra guarded group.
score: scripts/gate_calibrate.py: S as scripts/gate_local.py over dev31 against the r40 run, plus 2 x every policy group's worsening, 2 x the retired sealed set's worsening, and 2 x any T or P worsening beyond 1 %
